p.title: The home and briefing cards printed a position percentage next to a VIX ladder that disagreed with the VIX status
p.symptom: getActionPlan used a 15/20/25/30 VIX ladder with sizePct 100/80/50/30/15; the home market summary printed 'response: position N%' and the briefing page printed 'N% position —', while the status next to them and the snapshot label used 18/25/32 and the snapshot label still said 'panic'.
p.root_cause: P1534 moved the page ladders and the regime alert but not AIO_ACTION_RULES.positionSizing or the snapshot label, and P1535 removed sizePct from the readers' badges but not from these two sentences; the gates looked for old patterns, not for the ladder's edges.
p.fix: positionSizing has four bands with the shared edges and names and no sizePct; the home summary and briefing print the band name and its observation note; the snapshot label uses vixRegime. ci-domain-parity-check pins the ladder's edges, names and the absence of sizePct, and ci-control-char-check forbids the old sentence forms.
p.violated_rule: No trade instructions (sizing); one VIX band set (AGENTS.md, R696).
p.prevention: Legacy T216 (35 -> high-volatility band, edges at 17.9/18/24.9/25/31.9/32, no sizePct); parity gate P1557; phrase guard P1557.
p.verification: Parity, control-char and the legacy suite.
